import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Disclosure extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        contentId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        content: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    contentId: string;
    content: string | TemplateResult | undefined;
    private state;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    private toggle;
    willUpdate(): void;
    render(): TemplateResult<1>;
}
